newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's CDC sees two pct GDP growth in 1997.
newsitem.headline: France's CDC sees two pct GDP growth in 1997.

text.p: France's gross domestic product is expected to expand by two percent in 1997, Patrick Artus, director of economic studies at the Caisse des Depots et Consignations (CDC), said on Wednesday.

He said he did not believe French growth would rebound to a trend rate of 2.75 percent from 1998 unless investment rates, which have languished at 16 percent since 1993, rise to about 19 percent. "That's difficult to imagine today," he said, because of the long-term influence of high real interest rates.
Artus told a news conference he did not believe there would be a significant gap between French and German growth rates.
